entries.speaker: Irritated Mother
entries.en: You're going to be late for your lesson[n]if you don't hurry! Now, stop dawdling...!

entries.speaker: Sad Daughter
entries.en: ...I'm not dawdling.

entries.speaker: Sad Daughter
entries.en: Why do I have to take piano lessons?[n]I don't want to become a pianist...

entries.speaker: Irritated Mother
entries.en: Nonsense! You need to be more serious[n]about your lessons! It's for your future,[n]you know!

entries.speaker: Sad Daughter
entries.en: 'Kay, I'll see you later...

entries.speaker: Timid Daughter
entries.en: Mom, did you know that the Phantom[n]Thieves change people's hearts?

entries.speaker: Timid Daughter
entries.en: I wonder if that causes them to become[n]different people...

entries.speaker: Irritated Mother
entries.en: Enough. If you have time for such[n]nonsense, then you have time to[n]learn a new song.

entries.speaker: Irritated Mother
entries.en: We don't have much time until[n]the competition! No dinner if[n]you don't play well!

entries.speaker: Sad Daughter
entries.en: I don't want to do this anymore...[n]I wish my mom would turn into[n]another person...

entries.speaker: Timid Daughter
entries.en: My friends asked me to play volleyball[n]on our day off.

entries.speaker: Irritated Mother
entries.en: You can't! How will you play the piano[n]if you get injured!?

entries.speaker: Timid Daughter
entries.en: Then, how about we go somewhere?[n]All my friends are taking trips with[n]their families...

entries.speaker: Irritated Mother
entries.en: You can go anywhere in the world once[n]you become a pianist. You just need to[n]keep practicing.

entries.speaker: Irritated Mother
entries.en: It's almost time for the competition.[n]You have to win it, understand?

entries.speaker: Hysterical Mother
entries.en: What a disgraceful performance![n]That was the chance of a lifetime!

entries.speaker: Hysterical Mother
entries.en: Why...? Why can't you do this?[n]I NEED you to become a pianist!

entries.speaker: Hysterical Mother
entries.en: It's because you didn't rehearse![n]It's because you don't listen to me!

entries.speaker: Daughter About to Cry
entries.en: I'm sorry... I'm sorry... I'll take[n]more lessons... *sob*

entries.speaker: Hysterical Mother
entries.en: I'm the one who wants to cry![n]This is all YOUR fault!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like we found our target![n]Let's discuss this with the rest[n]of the group at the hideout!

entries.speaker: Crestfallen Mother
entries.en: When I was young I wanted to[n]become a pianist. I worked hard[n]and practiced a lot, but...

entries.speaker: Crestfallen Mother
entries.en: I'm sorry for forcing my dream[n]on you. You can do whatever[n]you want from now on.

entries.speaker: Kind Daughter
entries.en: I don't like it when you get mad, but I do[n]like the piano, so I want to keep playing it.

entries.speaker: Kind Daughter
entries.en: And someday, I'll become a pianist[n]and take you all over the world.

entries.speaker: Crestfallen Mother
entries.en: I'm sorry... Thank you.[n]Thank you...

entries.speaker: Kind Mother
entries.en: How about you, your dad, and me do[n]something together on your day off?

entries.speaker: Happy Daughter
entries.en: I want to go shopping with you,[n]then play with Dad...

entries.speaker: Happy Daughter
entries.en: Oh, and I want to go look at sheet[n]music too! I want to learn a new song!

entries.speaker: Kind Mother
entries.en: Of course. Okay, be careful.

entries.speaker: Happy Daughter
entries.en: Thanks, Mom! I'm going to[n]do my best at the lesson!

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: All these strange accidents are starting to[n]scare me. My hubby just got promoted—[n]can't have him dying.

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: What a horrible day and age we live in...[n]I only ask that he keeps my husband safe,[n]too.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Ohoho, he'll be fine working under my[n]hubbers—so long as he pulls his weight.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Can't have any slackers holding him back.[n]Ohoho...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Isn't your son a Shujin student? I hear it's[n]quite a strict school.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Must be challenging, what with so many[n]uncouth—ohoho, I mean "unique"—[n]students there.

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: It's true, he doesn't do terribly well in[n]school. Perhaps he got that from his[n]father. It's been tough.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Well, behind every great man is a great woman,[n]and behind every child a great mother. Ohoho...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: My hub-bub received an invitation to[n]Madarame's new exhibit. Would you[n]and your family care to join?

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: Oh, no. None of us would be able to[n]tell the good art from the bad.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Well, you'll never become more cultured[n]if you don't gain an appreciation for the[n]finer things.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Madarame's show was simply amazing.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: It left me utterly proud to be Japanese.[n]Ohoho...

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: So that was you I saw on TV during the[n]news coverage.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Oh my, was I really? I had no idea.[n]Ohoho...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: What an awful fraud that Madarame[n]turned out to be! He mustn't care an[n]inch about anyone but himself.

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: Plagiarizing, was it? And from his own[n]pupil, at that.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: You hear about that—people who pass[n]off another's hard work as their own.

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: Ohoho... Yes, my husband was quite[n]distraught about that as well.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: I keep hearing about all this blackmail[n]business—your hubs should keep an[n]eye out.

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: Fortunately, his salary is so low we'll[n]never have to worry about something[n]like that...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: That's so brave of you. We're much too[n]afraid to put ourselves at risk.

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: I suppose there are just things a rich family[n]like yours could never understand...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: I can't permit my son to be blackmailed![n]Why aren't the police doing more about[n]it!?

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: That must have been terrifying. What[n]happened?

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Terrifying indeed! Fortunately, he only[n]lost a cheap wallet. Couldn't have cost[n]more than 100,000 yen.

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: That would be unimaginable for us.[n]I should have expected nothing less[n]for your family though. Ohoho...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves took care of[n]the mafia, right? Serves them right for[n]causing my precious boy pain.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: I completely support the Phantom[n]Thieves now. Hopefully they bring[n]more bad apples to justice!

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: I can only imagine what the police[n]are doing. They haven't seemed very[n]reliable.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: I agree. Although, I'm sure they're[n]reevaluating how they handle crime[n]prevention.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Did you see that Medjed thing? It's time[n]for the Phantom Thieves to work their[n]magic again!

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: There's certainly nothing we can do.[n]It'd be awful if Medjed set their sights[n]on our company.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Exactly. Higher-ups like my hubby are[n]who need to step in if things go south.

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: Sometimes, I'm relieved my husband[n]hasn't climbed so high in the ranks.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves did it! I've been[n]on their side the whole time.

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: Everyone's all about the Phantom[n]Thieves now. They're all anyone on[n]TV talks about.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: I told my hubs he should sell a[n]Phantom Thieves-inspired burger.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Don't you think it'd be a big hit?[n]One must always have their finger[n]on the pulse.

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: How's your husband? The company[n]must be doing full-blown damage[n]control after that news report.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: It's all lies! Everyone's out to get[n]Okumura Foods because they're[n]jealous of its success!

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: Are you sure? My husband, he never[n]receives any overtime pay, so...

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: I wonder if they'll pin this on the CEO.[n]He should probably just admit the truth.[n]Ohoho...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: I hear they can't reach Okumura...[n]My hubberton's been working late[n]because of it all.

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: Well, the Phantom Thieves sent out[n]their calling card. Can't be good news[n]for the corporate bigwigs.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: The police need to get off their fat[n]asses and arrest those delinquents!

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: I thought you were a fan of the[n]Phantom Thieves? Ohoho, I know[n]times are tough right now, but...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: I can't believe Okumura collapsed![n]What does this mean for the company?

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: You need to relax. I'm sure the company[n]will be fine.

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: I mean, I'm sure there'll be massive[n]downsizing, not to mention demotions...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: But... My hubbers JUST got promoted![n]Damn you, Phantom Thieves!

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: Okumura Foods went through a real[n]rough patch. I heard your husband's[n]pay grade was severely reduced.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: I'm just glad the company survived in[n]one piece—and that my family's got[n]plenty in our savings.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: By the by, how's your guy? Oh, I'm[n]sorry—should I not ask?

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: Well, actually, because he helped with[n]the case so much, they promoted him[n]to CEO. Ohoho...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are still on the[n]loose, right? I'm so scared to be on my[n]own when the husbo's not home.

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: Alone? What about your maid? Have[n]you let the poor dear go?

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: We had to. Can't spare any unnecessary[n]expenses during this tumultuous time,[n]can we?

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: Such an admirable woman you've[n]become. Well, as they say, pride comes[n]before a fall. Ohoho...

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: That Shido fellow—the United Future[n]guy—seems quite nice. He should become[n]prime minister.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Ohoho... You know, I've actually met[n]Shido-san, during one of my hus-buddy's[n]functions.

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: Is that so? We just met him the other day,[n]while joining the supporters association.

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: He seemed quite nice. Were you at the[n]event?

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Did you see? The leader of the Phantom[n]Thieves is still alive!

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: I bet it's just a trick meant to discredit[n]Shido-san somehow!

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: That's what the talk shows are saying—[n]that it's just slander due to the elections.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: I'm worried about Shido-san's health.

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: Yes, we need him to bring real change[n]to Japan. My son is nearing his entrance[n]exams.

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: I want a better Japan waiting for him on[n]the other side.

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: Oh, Happy New Year. Last year was full[n]of surprises, wouldn't you agree...?

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Yes, truly. I'm quite shocked actually...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: ...Considering how extremely well the[n]business has performed, our family's[n]financial stability is even more solidified.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Besides that, my husband got promoted,[n]so he's been very busy...

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: What...? O-Oh, is that so...

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: Well, my husband actually got promoted[n]as well, so I guess they'll continue working[n]with each other quite often.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: I hear it's getting colder and colder[n]this winter...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: That's why we decided to spend our[n]winter on a private beach in Hawaii,[n]starting next month.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Winter should be much warmer over[n]there, so...

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: Wh-What!? That's... quite a long time[n]you're going to spend over there...

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: B-But I mean, we're planning on[n]heading to a private beach in Guam[n]next month as well, though!

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: My husband got a raise, so thankfully[n]we could afford it...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Wow, that sounds amazing! I'm glad[n]to hear that your family is doing well.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: I have a feeling this new year is going[n]to be another wonderful one.

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: Y-Yes... I think so too...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Hah. My husband told me that he was[n]selected as a main member for his next[n]project!

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: There's really been nothing but great[n]news lately.

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: I-I'm happy to hear that.

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: Work has been going great for my[n]husband too. He just landed a major[n]deal...

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: W-We're even considering having a[n]brand-new home built for us!

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: I feel like we're in a bargain sale of[n]happiness, you know!?

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Wow. So I guess you made it.

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: What...?

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: I mean, you're saying that things are[n]going so well for you that there's[n]nothing more left to desire, right?

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: ...But it sounds like you need to slow[n]it down a bit.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Perhaps you're being a little too greedy?[n]Everything depends on how you look[n]at it.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: You might be able to understand what[n]I mean, once you experience true[n]happiness. Hohoho...

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: I heard your husband was forced to retire.[n]That must've been hard on you both.

entries.speaker: Not-So-Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Yes... We may need to move in with my[n]parents. Temporarily, of course.

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: Well, if you ever need me to bring you[n]something from the city, please don't[n]hesitate to ask.

entries.speaker: Not-So-Modest Housewife
entries.en: I'm sure you'll miss the city dearly.[n]Ohoho...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: Your son is a Shujin student, correct?[n]Where that famous teacher got arrested...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: If I knew about such a teacher, I would've[n]had my child transferred to a different[n]school immediately.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: I always make sure that my child is writing[n]in a diary.

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: That way, I know what's going on at their[n]school.

entries.speaker: Modest Housewife
entries.en: Well, my son isn't on the volleyball team,[n]so I don't see the need for a diary...

entries.speaker: Arrogant Housewife
entries.en: We housewives are responsible for raising[n]a successful child, you know. We can't be[n]slacking off, ohoho...

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: Huh? What's gotten into you?

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: I'm yer boyfriend. I couldn't leave ya to[n]fend fer yourself while trains derail left[n]and right!

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: I just can't stop worryin' about you! I ain't[n]gonna let this city swallow ya whole!

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: Stop makin' such a fuss! You're[n]embarrassing me!

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: This city is fulla perverts and dangerous[n]criminals. It's no place fer people like us.[n]Let's go home.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: But it's been my dream to live here![n]Drop it already!

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: So ye're just gonna throw it all away?[n]Yer heritage? Yer home?

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: I'm not "throwing away" anything. I said[n]I'd come back home once a year to visit.[n]Isn't that enough?

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: The convenience stores here are so...[n]Well, convenient.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: You can get whatever ya need in the[n]country, too—just ask a neighbor!

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: I can take ya on fancy dates! We can go[n]fer a drive! I'll pick ya up in a limo or a[n]luxury car!

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: You mean a tractor or a truck.[n]Uh, no thanks. Not interested.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: I went out of my way to attend his exhibit[n]because he's sooo famous, but it turned[n]out he's a plagiarist!

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: I knew it! E'eryone in this city is a[n]degenerate liar!

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: I even hear there's a bunch a thieves on[n]the loose! C'mon, lemme take ya home.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: You're overreacting. Besides, the[n]Phantom Thieves are on our side!

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: The TV says there are criminals on the[n]loose. Ya gotta make sure ya lock yer[n]door at night.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: Yeah, yeah—the mafia, I know.[n]Relax, the city's perfectly safe.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: So is the country, thanks to Taro from[n]next door!

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: You mean that idiot dog who plays[n]with anyone who comes near him?[n]Real good guard dog.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: I want to go to a club and dance all night.[n]Maybe even have some cocktails.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: I went to a real good bar not long ago,[n]in Shinjuku.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: Manager there, she was real nice.[n]It was like bein' in heaven...

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: Did you... go to a hostess club?

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: I can rest easy knowing the mafia's[n]been shut down. Now I can just live[n]it up city-style all I want.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: This place ain't safe! There's those[n]creepy phantom thieves or whatever[n]runnin' wild.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: What if they snatch ya up in the dead[n]of night? C'mon, let's go back home.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: I said drop it already! I'm so sick[n]of hearing about the country!

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: If ya stay here, those bedhead slackers'll[n]break yer computer!

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: They're called Medjed, and they're[n]hackers. Anyway, they only target[n]corporations.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: Yer gonna get yourself in real hot water,[n]bein' so careless. If ya want, I can stand[n]guard tonight.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: Yeah, yeah...

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: Ya should come back home for Obon.[n]Besides, the city ain't safe because of[n]Medjeb.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: Geography doesn't matter on the[n]internet. Besides, the Phantom Thieves[n]will take care of them.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are just a myth![n]That's why they haven't responded!

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: Wake up. This city is built on lies!

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: Sorry fer sayin' the Phantom Thieves[n]were made up...

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: They're really somethin' else.[n]I wanna apprentice with 'em.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: I'm glad you're finally getting it.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: Yup. Lemme get ya somethin' nice from[n]the gift store back home, to show I'm[n]sorry.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: I take it back. You clearly don't get it yet!

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: That CEO's just plain evil. He don't care[n]about anyone but himself!

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves'll take care of[n]him, don't you worry. I hope they do[n]it soon, too.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: The fire department back home would've[n]come to the rescue right quick.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: Aaand this conversation's over.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: They left a new calling card.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: If the CEO has a change of heart, do you[n]think the burgers will get cheaper?

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: They opened one up back home not[n]long ago. Huge lines—you'd think it[n]was a festival or somethin'.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: I didn't know Bangarang Burgers was[n]so amazing.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: I could really go for a burger, but after[n]all that...

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: You talkin' about Bangarang?[n]I bet the whole company's goin' under.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: That CEO's face was... terrifyin'.[n]Those Phantom Thieves are ruthless.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are on the lam,[n]right? It's scary to think they could be[n]hiding nearby...

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: Does that mean ya finally wanna[n]come back home to the country?

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: No. I worked too hard to get here just[n]to leave now. Just gotta hope they're[n]caught soon.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: I'll keep ya safe. We're all real worried[n]'bout ya, y'know.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: Didja hear? Someone from our[n]elementary school is runnin' fer office.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: What, really!? Who? I wonder if we[n]were friends...

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: Well, he always said he wanted to make[n]our town better. It's a real uphill battle,[n]I hear, though.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: I don't care how bad things are,[n]suicide should never be the answer.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: Doin' that to yer mom and dad...[n]That's not a good way to go.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: Yeah, it doesn't sit well with me either.[n]There was no reason for him to die.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: It's just as much our fault, too![n]After the shit we said about 'im!

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: You're right, sorry... No one's ever[n]taken that tone with me before.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: Is Shido a bad man? Should we be[n]believin' in the Phantom Thieves?

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: Either way, we have to watch and wait.[n]There's nothing else we can do.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: ...I don't know what I'm supposed to[n]be accomplishin'... Feelin' real lost in[n]this concrete jungle.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: I'm surprised to hear that you feel lost.

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: So, I think I'm gonna move back home.[n]You gonna stay in the city?

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman
entries.en: Huh? Yeah... Why the sudden change?

entries.speaker: Rural Young Man
entries.en: Bein' here's made it clear. Tokyo ain't for[n]me. Besides, I wanna show support for[n]our school mate runnin' for election.

entries.speaker: Adorable Woman

entries.en: Everybody looks so happy all of a sudden.

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
entries.en: What in the world's going on? It's almost[n]creepy...

entries.speaker: Homeless Man

entries.speaker: Homeless Man

entries.speaker: Homeless Man

entries.speaker: Homeless Man

entries.speaker: Homeless Man
